orientations.intent: Determine whether the available tools can retrieve a receipt from an external artifact vault.

final_message: No — the available tools (repo, tests, git, episodes handles) only provide repository status/build, test running, git operations, and episode history. None of them offer functionality to connect to or retrieve artifacts (like receipts) from an external artifact vault or storage system. There is no such capability exposed among the reachable calls.

files.content: Begin at breadcrumbs/start.txt to locate the requested receipt.

blue receipt -> vault/blue/receipt.dat
red receipt -> vault/red/receipt.dat
